request:
Which classes inherit from httpx's `RequestError` exception (httpx/_exceptions.py), either directly or through any number of intermediate classes? Exclude RequestError itself. Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Recursively walks code.class_bases starting from classes whose base resolves to httpx/_exceptions.py::RequestError, collecting all transitive subclasses. RequestError itself is excluded and each distinct symbol ID is returned once.
sql: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_symbol_id = 'httpx/_exceptions.py::RequestError' UNION SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN descendants d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id) SELECT DISTINCT symbol_id FROM descendants WHERE symbol_id <> 'httpx/_exceptions.py::RequestError' ORDER BY symbol_id
